sources.title: Student Card Collection Schedule
exampleQuestions: When can I collect my student card?

text.en: For Non-JUPAS students whose digital photo was uploaded by 2 August 2026, collection is on the assigned date and time in the New Student Briefing: 10 or 11 August at WYS201, or 24 August at WLB103/WLB104.
text.zhHant: Non-JUPAS 學生如在 2026 年 8 月 2 日前上載電子相片，須按新生簡介指定日期及時間領證：8 月 10 或 11 日於 WYS201，或 8 月 24 日於 WLB103/WLB104。
text.zhHans: Non-JUPAS 学生如在 2026 年 8 月 2 日前上传电子照片，须按新生简介指定日期及时间领证：8 月 10 或 11 日在 WYS201，或 8 月 24 日在 WLB103/WLB104。

sources.title: Replacement of Student Card
exampleQuestions: How much is a replacement student card?

text.en: A replacement student card currently carries a HK$100 fee; report a lost card to Academic Registry promptly and re-check the fee before applying.
text.zhHant: 補領學生證現時收費為港幣 100 元；遺失後應盡快向教務處報失，申請前再核對最新收費。
text.zhHans: 补领学生证目前收费为港币 100 元；遗失后应尽快向教务处报失，申请前再核对最新收费。

claims.sourceLocator: Replacement of Student Card: items 1-2

sources.title: Account and Password
exampleQuestions: How do I activate my SSOid?

text.en: New students register their SSOid after receiving their student number from Academic Registry, using the official account page.
text.zhHant: 新生收到教務處發出的學生編號後，才經官方帳戶頁註冊 SSOid。
